name: Map Global Crop Health
description: Track broad vegetation patterns and seasonal change from a consistent Earth-observation orbit.
tooltip: Prioritize spectral coverage and enough downlink for repeated imaging.

name: Monitor Urban Heat
description: Measure temperature differences across cities to support heat-risk research.
tooltip: Thermal coverage and data-return capacity are especially valuable.

name: Study the Lunar Magnetic Environment
description: Characterize magnetic-field variation near the Moon over an extended campaign.
tooltip: A lunar trajectory increases propulsion requirements but enables new measurements.
